title: Reserve In Advance:  Active Aging Yoga & Core
description:
Enjoy this energizing blend of yoga and core focused exercises, with the strength of other parts of the body will also be enhanced such as the back and legs. Breathing practice will also be introduced for balancing the energy level and nervous system. Suitable for both beginners and participants with yoga experience core exercises and yoga stretches for seniors. A Thera-band may be used. End the class with a beautiful relaxing savasana. Be strong from the inside out in this moderate level yoga/moving meditation class with core exercises.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

description: Unwind & restore in this gentle class that combines the healing vibrations of sound with the deeply relaxing practice of Restorative Yoga. Using supportive props to hold restful postures for longer periods, this practice activates the parasympathetic nervous system, allowing your body to release tension, stress, & fatigue.As you settle into each pose you will be immersed in the soothing sounds of crystal singing bowl, chimes & meditiation. These sound frequencies work to balance your energy, quiet the mind & promote inner healing.

title: Reserve in Advance: Figure Skating
description:
Practice the sport of Figure Skating at this drop-in. Participants must wear figure skates and confidently skate at Star 2+ (backwards cross over, 3-turns, toeloop, back spin). Skaters must have their own skates. (Recreational skates are not appropriate).
Reserved spots will be forfeited 10 minutes after the program has started. Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. No waitlist. Participants must have their own equipment.
Coaching is not permitted.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Get a great workout with a casual game of hockey. CSA-approved helmet with face mask or visor and hockey gloves are mandatory. Full hockey gear is recommended. No-check rules apply. Goalies must wear full gear. Not supervised.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Recreational Hockey
description:
Full hockey equipment and a CSA-approved helmet with face mask or visor and hockey gloves are strongly recommended. Games are not supervised and no-check rule apply. Reserve in advance online or drop-in if spots are available. 2 days in advance for Burnaby residents. 1 day in advance for non-Burnaby residents.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Adult Basketball
description:
Please arrive early and check in with staff at the gymnasium to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult. Reserve in advance is available for this activity, check-in prior to activity start time to avoid losing your reservation. Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. No waitlist.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is available for this activity, check-in prior to activity start time to avoid losing your reservation. Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. No waitlist.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Table Tennis All Ages
description:
Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. For all ages programs, children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Table Tennis All Ages
description:
Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. For all ages programs, children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

description:
Reserve in advance is available for this activity. This classical form of yoga is a rejuvenating practice that releases tension from the muscles accumulated in everyday life and sports activities. Learn to breathe deeply while experiencing a variety of postures to stimulate the body physically and mentally. Through this practice you enhance flexibility, increase muscle tone and concentration, detoxify the organs and feel a state of deep relaxation. A variation of poses will be offered with an emphasis on the core muscles.

Participants arriving less than 20 minutes BEFORE the activity start time forfeit their reserved spot. In consideration of others wishing to participate, please withdraw from your activity if you are unable to attend.Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is available for this activity, check-in prior to activity start time to avoid losing your reservation. Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. No waitlist.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Combo Court- Squash ONLY
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Squash.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Combo Court Reservations as per the Combo Court Squash or Racquet Ball per day schedule ONLY*

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Squash Court #1
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for the sports of Squash and Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for the sports of Squash and Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

prices.description: Child (6-14 yrs) fee for up to 14 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

title: Reserve In Advance: Table Tennis All Ages
description:
Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. For all ages programs, children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. For all ages programs, children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

prices.description: Child (6-14 yrs) fee for up to 14 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

prices.description: Child (6-14 yrs) fee for up to 14 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

prices.description: Child (6-14 yrs) fee for up to 14 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Squash.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Squash.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is available for this activity, check-in prior to activity start time to avoid losing your reservation.
Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. No waitlist.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Please arrive early and check in at the gymnasium to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

*Note this program is a 1/4 court and one net*Please arrive early and check in at the gymnasium to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Badminton Adult
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is available for this activity, check-in prior to activity start time to avoid losing your reservation.
Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. No waitlist.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Reserve in advance is available for this activity. This classical form of yoga is a rejuvenating practice that releases tension from the muscles accumulated in everyday life and sports activities. Learn to breathe deeply while experiencing a variety of postures to stimulate the body physically and mentally. Through this practice you enhance flexibility, increase muscle tone and concentration, detoxify the organs and feel a state of deep relaxation. A variation of poses will be offered.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Combo Court- Squash ONLY
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Squash.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Squash.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for the sports of Squash and Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

prices.description: Child (6-14 yrs) fee for up to 14 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

title: Reserve In Advance: Combo Court- Racquetball ONLY
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Combo Court- Squash ONLY
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Squash.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Reserve in advance is available for this activity. A revitalizing, gentle and meditative class. Focus on gently strengthening and stretching the body in a supportive, relaxed way with an emphasis on healing. Perfect for those who want more flexibility. Enjoy improved circulation, a calm mind and relaxed elongated muscles. All levels of fitness and abilities welcome.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Table Tennis All Ages
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. For all ages, children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult. Please arrive earl and check in at the front counter to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Badminton All Ages
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult. Reserve in advance is available for this activity, check-in prior to activity start time to avoid losing your reservation. Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. No waitlist.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Table Tennis All Ages
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. For all ages, children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult. Please arrive earl and check in at the front counter to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Combo Court - Squash ONLY
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for the sports of Squash.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There is one convertible court (combo court). Bookings in combo court are as per Combo-Squash/Racquetball schedule only.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Pilates
description:

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for the sports of Squash.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

prices.description: Child (12-14 yrs) fee for up to 14 years old
Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for the sports of Squash.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

prices.description: Child (12-14 yrs) fee for up to 14 years old
Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for the sports of Squash.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

prices.description: Child (12-14 yrs) fee for up to 14 years old
Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.
